corrections.claim: Optimizer feasibility or a halted state alone is an enforced broker kill switch.
corrections.correction: Tagged native risk code has submit/modify throttles, per-instrument notional bounds and Halted/Reducing checks. bypass skips trading-state enforcement; state changes alone do not prove open-order cancellation/position flattening or broker recovery.

corrections.claim: Installing WalkForward/CPCV or a recorded reserved segment removes leakage and yields a fresh holdout.
corrections.correction: WalkForward purge defaults to zero and must match label/execution timing. The recorded 2021Q1 reserved control is already inspected, uses raw-price labels and a 20bp cost proxy, and is not portfolio total-return evidence.

corrections.claim: Latest optimizer features or release fixes constitute accepted improvements over skfolio 1.2.9.
corrections.correction: Both inspected revisions already expose transaction costs, turnover/CVaR bounds and fallback. 1.4.10 fixes are specific source leads; retain 1.2.9 until solver failure and cost/constraint behavior pass a matched native comparison.

evidence_assessment: Pinned crates/risk/src/engine/config.rs:49-55 has bypass, submit/modify rates and per-instrument notional map; an empty/default map is not a frozen complete risk policy. crates/risk/tests/risk_engine.rs includes positive/negative controls for bypass, notional bounds and trading state. These original upstream tests were read, not executed.

The historical skfolio receipt is accepted_for_causal_raw_price_label_control_only. Its fixed cost proxy, inspected reserved segment, omitted distributions, limited ETF sample and no reconciled cash/fee/fill/capacity model remain preserved.

PyPortfolioOpt is a matched optimizer baseline; CVXPortfolio is a supported multi-period/cost/constraint comparator when that missing policy contract becomes required. Neither supplies selected-broker enforcement. HFT replay additionally assumes orders do not alter the market.
